summary_en: Yasuda Logistics raised its full-year dividend forecast for FY2027 from ¥74 to ¥78 per share (pre-split basis), increasing the interim dividend by ¥2 to ¥39 and revising the year-end forecast to ¥19.50 (¥39 pre-split equivalent) following a ¥800 million upward revision to net profit to ¥7.0 billion.
title_en: Notice on Revision of FY2027 Consolidated Business Forecast and Modification of Interim and Year-end Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Yasuda Logistics revised upward its dividend policy for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, following a significant improvement in profit forecasts. The company raised its forecast for net profit attributable to parent company shareholders from ¥6.2 billion to ¥7.0 billion, an increase of ¥800 million (12.9%), largely due to gains from the sale of investment securities recorded during the interim period. In response to this stronger profit outlook and in line with its medium-term management plan dividend policy, the company increased the interim dividend from ¥37 to ¥39 per share (payable December 4, 2026, on the basis of the record date of September 30, 2026). Total interim dividend payments reached ¥1,118 million. The year-end dividend forecast was also revised to ¥19.50 per share on a post-split basis (equivalent to ¥39 pre-split), bringing the full-year dividend to ¥78 per share on a pre-split basis, up from the previous forecast of ¥74 per share. The company is scheduled to execute a 2-for-1 stock split effective January 1, 2027.
